newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Farm Credit sets rates on $2.005 bln bonds.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Farm Credit sets rates on $2.005 bln bonds.

text.p: The Federal Farm Credit Bank Funding Corp said Monday it set interest rates on two issues of Federal Farm Credit Banks Consolidated Systemwide Bonds totaling $2.005 billion. The issues will be dated and delivered January 2, 1997.
The first issue is for $1.659 billion with an interest rate of 5.25 percent with a spread of +15. It matures on April 1, 1997. It carries a concession of $0.20 per $1,000.
The second issue is for $346 million with an interest rate of 5.34 percent with a spread of +5. It matures on July 1, 1997.
It carries a concession of $0.30 per $1,000.
